construct_ontology: social communication and autistic social traits

metadata.description: Rating-scale family for social communication, restricted interests, and social responsiveness across development.
metadata.intended_use: Clinical, educational, and research assessment of social functioning and autism-related traits.
metadata.name_origin: Social Responsiveness Scale, second edition, abbreviated SRS-2.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a multi-informant scale with age- and informant-specific forms.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Social communication and repetitive/restricted behavior are rated dimensionally across everyday contexts.
metadata.interpretation_notes: SRS-2 scores are not sufficient for an autism diagnosis and can be influenced by language, ADHD, anxiety, and other conditions.
